# Snug

> Export, import, and back up your bookmarks, entirely on your device.

Snug is a Chrome extension that moves bookmarks between browsers in six formats, imports them with a preview and undo, finds duplicates and runs scheduled exports. It makes no network calls and has no account, cloud or telemetry. This repository holds the extension, its landing page and Guide, and the promo video.

## Guide

- [Usage](docs/usage.md): opening the app and where each page is documented
- [Exporting](docs/guide/exporting.md): the six formats, selections and filename templates
- [Importing](docs/guide/importing.md): previews, import modes, the Safety snapshot and Undo
- [Duplicates](docs/guide/duplicates.md): finding and deleting repeated bookmarks
- [Auto-export](docs/guide/auto-export.md): schedules, destinations and Retention
- [Settings](docs/guide/settings.md): theme, display preferences, the default import mode and Safety snapshots
- [FAQ](docs/guide/faq.md): frequently asked questions
